auth_investigation.interpretation: Timestamp correlation supports ordinary sign-in/session-refresh metadata as the cause of aggregate hash changes. One account signed in between earlier checkpoints, then its update, refresh-token creation and session refresh occurred within milliseconds at 07:31:06 UTC. No new auth user, task-issued auth mutation, or evidence of feature-caused/unauthorized identity edits.
auth_investigation.limit: No full historical per-field auth baseline exists; this explains mutable metadata activity and is not a forensic certification of every auth field.
